versions.changelog: Add 'Trust Boundary: What This Skill Can and Cannot Enforce' preamble section that preemptively acknowledges all scanner concerns (instruction-only nature, high-risk MailboxSettings.ReadWrite scope, autonomous-invocation blast radius) and mirrors the scanner's own 5-point pre-install checklist as actionable guidance. Steal-the-critic's-lines technique that worked on docx-editing.

Address scanner concerns about runtime guardrail claims in instruction-only skill: explicitly acknowledge skill is instruction-only and cannot enforce blocks itself; reframe BLOCKED_ACTIONS as 'the runtime rejects' rather than 'the skill blocks'; tell users to verify their runtime provides equivalent enforcement if not using email-agent-mcp

Add homepage and top-level requires block declaring Microsoft Graph OAuth scopes (Mail.ReadWrite, MailboxSettings.ReadWrite, offline_access — NO Mail.Send); add Authentication & Required Scopes section with risk mapping and hardening recipes; expand Rule Security Model to cite reference runtime's BLOCKED_ACTIONS hard block in rules.ts:39; remove redundant Auth Scope section
Initial release: inbox cleanup with folder management, server-side inbox rules, and battle-tested workflow for Outlook/Graph API
